nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Vite + React + TypeScript template README documenting the minimal setup, official React plugins, React Compiler notes, and ESLint configuration expansion guidance for production use.

nodes.name: index.html
nodes.summary: HTML entry point that mounts the React application via a single root div and loads the Vite-served module script at /src/main.tsx, with an inline SVG cable-mini-mark favicon.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: NPM package manifest declaring React 19, xyflow, cmdk, and phosphor-icons as runtime dependencies, plus Vite/TypeScript/ESLint/Vitest/Playwright dev tooling and the dev/build/lint/test/e2e scripts.

nodes.name: tsconfig.app.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript project configuration for the web application using bundler mode with react-jsx, strict unused-locals/parameters, and path aliases that mirror vite.config.ts to resolve monorepo packages from source.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses TS7 moduleResolution: bundler with paths (no baseUrl) to map @pactify-apps/* monorepo packages directly to their source entry files.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: Solution-style TypeScript configuration file that orchestrates project references to tsconfig.app.json (application code) and tsconfig.node.json (Vite config) without compiling any files itself.

nodes.name: tsconfig.node.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript project configuration for the Node-side build tooling (vite.config.ts) using ES2023, bundler moduleResolution, and strict unused-locals/parameters checks.

nodes.name: vercel.json
nodes.summary: Vercel deployment configuration that pins the install command (npm ci plus the cloud monorepo pnpm install), runs tsc -b followed by vite build into dist, and exposes that directory as the framework output.
